messages:
lina.sales: Hey CS team — handing off Parallax Labs (signed today). Main asks: Private deployment in EU region, SOC2 in-scope, and a 30-day pilot with ramp to dedicated capacity after success. Leaving background: expected pilot volume ~8k tokens/day, spike to 50k/day on go-live. Renewal target is 2025-09, but they mentioned platform consolidation in 9-12 months.

omar.csm: Thanks Lina. Adding owners. Quick Q: who is the infra contact and do we have legal SOW notes re: SOC2? Also confirm whether they need VPC peering or private cluster.

lina.sales: Infra contact is marco@parallax.io. SOW uploaded to Drive (Parallax_SOW_1711). They want a private cluster (Redwood Private) with customer-managed KMS. Also asked for audit log retention 1 year. Finance agreed to a 60-day POC credit; Lina to send signed confirmation.

omar.csm: Ok. Owners: Omar = CSM; Sasha = Support (primary); Lee = Eng (Private deploy lead). I'll schedule kickoff and send the activation checklist. Pilot success criteria (proposal): 1) p95 latency <250ms for 90% of routes; 2) no more than 2% classification regressions on eval set; 3) Uptime >= 99.5 during pilot. Thoughts?

sasha.support: Sounds good. I'll open ticket SUP-8120 for the deployment triage and add runbook items: KMS integration steps, cert exchange, firewall allowlist, SAML/Okta validation. I'll include a monitoring dashboard stub and alert thresholds. ETA ticket by EOD.

ops-bot: infra-provision request created: private-cluster-eu-parallax queued (owner: lee.eng)

lee.eng: Noted. We need Marco to provide network CIDRs and KMS key ARN. Also: private cluster rollout will take ~3 business days after creds. Proposed test window: 2024-04-01 08:00-09:00 UTC for initial connectivity smoke test. I'll create RFC-2099 for the private deploy checklist and quantization validation for their models.

omar.csm: I'll request CIDRs and KMS from Marco in the kickoff invite. Also tagging renewal risk: medium because of consolidation signal. Action: quarterly business reviews and feature adoption dashboard. Lina, please share the signed 60-day credit email so Finance can formalize billing hold.

lina.sales: Sent the credit confirmation to finance and cc'd Omar: "Parallax confirms 60-day POC credit up to €2,000". Forwarded.

sasha.support: SUP-8120 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-8120  attachments: onboarding-checklist.md, dashboard-prototype.png. Adding runbook steps:
- Day 0: Access + cert exchange + Okta SAML test user
- Day 1: Private cluster deploy (staging) + KV cache warm-up
- Week 1: Pilot ingest + eval set run, baseline metrics
- Week 2-4: Quality tuning, monitor error-rate and latency, prepare for Prod roll if criteria met

lee.eng: Also note: Parallax plans to request private model variants next quarter. We'll need a small spike to verify quant profiles on EU infra. Mark RFC-2099 as low effort but required before production ramp.

omar.csm: Owners & immediate next steps:
- Omar (CSM): Send kickoff invite, collate docs, success metrics, schedule QBR cadence
- Sasha (Support): SUP-8120 triage + dashboard + runbook (ETA: ticket open today)
- Lee (Eng): Create RFC-2099, schedule private cluster provisioning (ETA: provisioning queued)
- Lina (Sales): Confirmed 60-day credit email and intro to Marco (infra)

lina.sales: Looping Marco in: @marco.parallax please share CIDR ranges, KMS key ARN, and preferred maintenance window. Also loop in your security contact if SOC2 paperwork is needed.

omar.csm: I'll set Account Health = "onboarding: in progress" and Renewal Watch = "medium" in the CRM. Adding an enablement ask: guest access to Parallax product owner for a 30-min walkthrough next week.

sasha.support: Added basic dashboard (token usage, route p50/p95, 5xx rate) to SUP-8120. Will post link after Parallax cluster is online. Also scheduling a troubleshooting drill for SAML flows during Day 0.

lee.eng: Provisioning job started; tracking ID infra-4561. Kicking off canary once Marco shares network info. If peering required, will coordinate maintenance window.

omar.csm: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the smoke test. If any blocker arises, escalate in #eng-oncall and ping @lee.eng. :white_check_mark:
